item.title: Mahfuz, Asif set to join NCP to contest in nat'l polls

item.title: Choose between freedom and backward forces: Fakhrul
item.description: Bangladeshis must decide whether they choose freedom, sovereignty, and democracy, or the regressive forces that opposed independence, BNP Secretary General Fakhrul Islam Alamgir said on Sunday.Speaking at a discussion meeting organized by Muktijoddha Dal, marking Martyred Intellectuals Day at the Diploma Engineers Institution auditorium, he said, "Two forces are clearly active around the upcoming elections. item.title: DB picks up journalist Anis Alamgir for 'questioning'
item.description: Journalist Anis Alamgir was taken to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Detective Branch (DB) office on Sunday evening. Speaking to the media from the DB office, he said he was picked up around 7:30 pm from a gym in Dhanmondi and reached the office by 8:00 pm. "I was taken from a gym in Dhanmondi. The DB officials told me their chief wants to speak with me," Alamgir said. item.title: Politicisation of bureaucracy a threat to governance: ACC Chief
item.description: Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) Chairman Dr. Mohammad Abdul Momen on Sunday warned that a disturbing reversal in the relationship between politicians and bureaucrats is threatening state governance. He observed that bureaucrats are increasingly approaching politicians to pledge allegiance, rather than maintaining administrative neutrality.Speaking at a Citizens' Platform programme in Dhaka, Dr. Momen said, "Earlier, politicians used to approach bureaucrats. item.title: School bus accident in Colombia kills 17

item.title: India beats SA by 7 wickets to take 2-1 lead in T20 series

item.title: Attack on Hadi: Case filed after 2 days

item.title: Complaint filed against Anis, Shaon, 2 others
item.description: A complaint has been filed with at Uttara West Police Station against journalist Anis Alamgir, actress Meher Afroz Shaon and two others.But it has not yet been registered as a formal case.The complaint was lodged around 2AM on Monday by Arian Ahmed, central organiser of the July Revolutionary Alliance, under the Anti-Terrorism Act.The other two named in the complaint are Maria Kispotta and Imtu Ratish Imtiaz.Journo Anis Alamgir taken into DB custody
